vojtamaur.cz – Complete Website Archive (English Edition)

This gallery is an experimental archival edition of the personal website of Czech artist Vojta Maur (https://vojtamaur.cz/).

The website's content has been converted into sequentially numbered images to preserve and distribute it independently of conventional web hosting, PDF readers, and the original website infrastructure.
This edition is part of a broader long-term preservation project exploring digital redundancy, unconventional distribution channels, and the survival of information across different platforms and media.

Original website: https://vojtamaur.cz/
Project documentation: https://vojtamaur.cz/metawebovy-clanek/
Technical documentation: https://vojtamaur.cz/documentation/
All content is published by its original author.
